[[Bill Rogers]] ([[AG152]]-[[JN138]])| java1=[[Katsuyuki Konishi]]| }} '''Ash's Corphish''' (Japanese: '''サトシのヘイガニ''' ''Satoshi's Heigani'') was the third {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that {{Ash}} {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Hoenn]] [[region]], and his twenty-fifth overall. ==In animation== ===History=== ===={{aniseries|AG}}==== =====Hoenn===== [[File:Ash greeting Corphish.png|thumb|220px|Corphish being welcomed to Ash's team]] [[File:Ash Corphish saying hello.png|thumb|220px|left|Corphish's way of saying hello]] Corphish debuted in ''[[AG023|Gone Corphishin']]''. Ash and his friends were camping on a [[Dewford Town|Dewford Island]] beach, and Corphish was attacking them from underneath the sand. Eventually, his identity was revealed and Ash battled and caught him using his {{AP|Treecko}}. In the [[AG024|next episode]], when Corphish met the group's other Pokémon, he struggled to make friends, smacking the others to greet them and eating their food. Corphish later fell ill after eating some seaweed and rope and was carried to the [[Dewford Town]] [[Pokémon Center]] for treatment. The next morning he had recovered and was able to stop Team Rocket's plan. Corphish had his first [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} in ''[[AG031|Just One of the Geysers]]'' against [[Brawly]], where he was chosen to battle his {{p|Machop}}. Corphish won the round, though he later fell to {{TP|Brawly|Hariyama}}. In ''[[AG056|Going, Going, Yawn!]]'', Ash selected Corphish to participate in his Gym battle against [[Flannery]], due to his type advantage over the [[Lavaridge Gym]]'s {{t|Fire}} Pokémon. Corphish took on Flannery's {{p|Magcargo}}, managing to overcome his opponent's defensive tactics such as {{m|Sandstorm}} and win the round. Later, after Treecko's failed attempt, Corphish was sent out to take on {{p|Slugma}}. However, Corphish had to be [[recall]]ed after Slugma used {{m|Yawn}} to put him to {{status|sleep}}. Ash then sent him out to battle Flannery's {{p|Torkoal}}, but he was still asleep and took several fiery hits as a result. Corphish woke up more persistent than ever, using {{m|Crabhammer}} to overcome Torkoal's {{m|Iron Defense}}. As Torkoal emerged dizzy from the blows, Corphish finished it off with {{m|Bubble Beam}}, earning Ash the {{badge|Heat}}. In ''[[AG067|Go Go Ludicolo!]]'', Corphish was sent out while Ash was deliberating on his [[Petalburg Gym]] strategy. Corphish immediately got angry and jealous of Ash's newly evolved {{AP|Grovyle}}, particularly after he failed to retrieve fruit from a tree, as well as failing to break {{TRT}}'s net with his pincers, both of which Grovyle did easily with {{m|Leaf Blade}}. Later, Corphish got in Grovyle's way in order to volunteer to battle {{OBP|Poncho|AG067}} and his {{p|Ludicolo}}. However, Corphish struggled as his Crabhammer and Bubble Beam attacks were dodged by Ludicolo's dancing skills and defenses. He was then hit by Ludicolo's {{m|Focus Punch}} and eventually defeated by {{m|Hyper Beam}}. Determined to prove himself, Corphish caught up with Poncho and angrily demanded another battle, but he then had to rescue Poncho and Ludicolo from Team Rocket. He singlehandedly defeated {{TP|Jessie|Seviper}} and {{TP|James|Cacnea}}, impressing Poncho, who admitted that his earlier win might have just been luck. In ''[[AG099|It's Still Rocket Roll to Me!]]'', Corphish saved [[Max]] and one of the [[Mossdeep Gym]] Leaders, [[Tate and Liza|Tate]], when they were captured aboard a space shuttle that had been hijacked by Team Rocket. Having snuck aboard the shuttle while following the food, he discovered Max and Tate tied up in the cockpit and cut the ropes holding them, allowing Tate to use {{TP|Tate|Solrock}} to knock Team Rocket out. [[File:Takeshi's Paradise with Corphish.png|thumb|left|220px|Corphish and Brock left exhausted after performing "[[Takeshi's Paradise]]"]] In ''[[AG105|Once in a Mawile]]'', Corphish fell in love with a {{p|Mawile}}, but the feeling was not mutual since Mawile was in love with [[Brock's Lombre]]. He teamed up with {{an|Brock}} to sing and dance to "[[Takeshi's Paradise]]" in order to keep an audience entertained. In ''[[AG110|The Great Eight Fate!]]'', Ash chose Corphish to replace his {{AP|Snorunt}} in the [[Double Battle]] in the first round of the [[Sootopolis Gym]] battle. He went up against [[Juan]]'s {{p|Sealeo}} and {{p|Seaking}} along with {{AP|Pikachu}}. Corphish's defenses allowed him and Pikachu to endure Sealeo's attacks and defeat it, ending the first round of the battle in Ash's favor. In the [[AG111|next episode]], Corphish took on Juan's {{p|Luvdisc}}, managing to overcome its {{a|Swift Swim}} [[Ability]] and win. Corphish then went up against Juan's {{p|Whiscash}}, but he was defeated by a {{m|Surf}} and {{m|Rock Smash}} combination. In the [[Ever Grande Conference]], Corphish was used in several battles. He first teamed up with {{AP|Torkoal}} in ''[[AG127|From Brags to Riches]]'' to battle [[Dominick]]. After Torkoal fainted, Corphish defeated {{p|Swalot}} alone, which he did by using Bubble Beam in Swalot's mouth. In ''[[AG129|A Judgment Brawl]]'', Ash used Corphish as his fourth Pokémon in his [[Full Battle]] against {{ho|Katie}} in the Victory Tournament. He went up against her {{p|Golduck}} on the water field, and despite getting {{status|confusion|confused}} by Golduck's {{m|Confusion}}, Corphish was more or less able to understand Ash's commands and defeat the Duck Pokémon. Corphish next went up against Katie's {{p|Venomoth}}, though Ash recalled him in favor of {{AP|Swellow}} to get the type advantage. He sent him back out later to take on Katie's last Pokémon, {{p|Walrein}}. Although now free from his confusion, Corphish's Bubble Beam wasn't enough to stop Walrein's powerful {{m|Body Slam}}, which knocked Corphish right out on impact. [[File:Ash Corphish vs Morrison Swampert.png|thumb|220px|Corphish clashing against Morrison's Swampert]] Ash [[AG130|later]] used Corphish as his first Pokémon in his Full Battle against [[Morrison]] in the Victory Tournament, with {{p|Girafarig}} as his opponent. Morrison was unable to control his emotions due to grief over being forced to battle his close friend, Ash, causing him to give Girafarig useless commands, thus allowing Corphish to trounce it. In the [[AG130|next episode]], Ash saved the motionless Morrison from being disqualified by convincing him to continue battling, and he reluctantly picked {{p|Growlithe}}. With the type advantage and Morrison continuing to make poor move choices, Corphish made quick work of Growlithe as well. Ash further tried to encourage Morrison out of his slump, and he finally got through to him. Morrison then sent out his {{p|Swampert}} and gave it much smarter commands, leading Corphish to tie with it. In ''[[AG131|At the End of the Fray]]'', Ash used Corphish as his third Pokémon in his Full Battle against {{ho|Tyson}}, going up against {{p|Hariyama}}. After a short exchange of moves, Corphish's Crabhammer collided with Hariyama's {{m|Focus Punch}}, with the latter prevailing and knocking Corphish out in one shot. =====Kanto Battle Frontier===== [[File:Corphish and Swellow battling Tucker.png|thumb|220px|left|Corphish and Swellow teaming up against Tucker]] Back at [[Pallet Town]], in ''[[AG133|The Right Place and the Right Mime]]'', Corphish met and soon befriended Ash's other crustacean-like Pokémon, {{AP|Kingler}}. In ''[[AG153|Tactics Theatrics!!]]'', he teamed up with {{p|Swellow}} to battle [[Tucker]] and his {{p|Arcanine}} and Swampert. Tucker took early control of the battle by canceling out Corphish and Swellow's attacks by making full use of Arcanine's superior speed and Swampert's defenses, then going on offense and having his Pokémon use tactful combinations, including a brutal water and fire fusion attack, all of which pushed Corphish and Swellow to their limits. However, Ash was clever enough to come up with strategies to circumvent all of Tucker's combinations, including having Corphish counter Arcanine's {{m|Fire Blast}} with Bubble Beam, creating a huge cloud of steam that allowed him and Swellow to blindside Arcanine and Swampert with powerful finishing moves, thus winning Ash the [[Tactics Symbol]]. In ''[[AG169|Talking a Good Game!]]'', he battled [[Anabel]]'s {{p|Alakazam}} and lost. In the [[AG170|next episode]], however, he was able to beat Alakazam in a [[rematch]], only to be beaten by her {{p|Metagross}} shortly thereafter. Corphish danced with Brock to the same song as they did in ''Once in a Mawile'', albeit a new version, in ''[[AG184|Strategy Tomorrow - Comedy Tonight!]]''. In ''[[AG186|Overjoyed!]]'', in an attempt for Ash to warm up for his rematch against [[Brandon]], [[Nurse Joy]] decided to battle Ash with her {{TP|Nurse Joy|Chansey}}. As none of Corphish's attacks did any damage to Chansey, Chansey went on to defeat him with {{m|Solar Beam}}. Ash left Corphish at {{an|Professor Oak}}'s lab when he left for [[Sinnoh]]. ===={{aniseries|DP}}==== In ''[[DP182|An Old Family Blend!]]'', Corphish was first seen in a fountain alongside {{AP|Totodile}} and happily greeted his Trainer. Later, he helped to battle one of [[Team Rocket's mechas]] with his Bubble Beam. He also helped put out a fire, along with Totodile and {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}}, that was accidentally started by {{AP|Cyndaquil}}. Corphish was not seen participating in the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]]. ===={{aniseries|BW}}==== Corphish was reunited with Ash in ''[[BW142|The Dream Continues!]]'', where he and the rest of Ash's Pokémon posed in a group photo with him. ===={{aniseries|SM}}==== Corphish briefly appeared in ''[[SM042|Alola, Kanto!]]'', where he was seen swimming underwater at a pond near Oak's Laboratory with Totodile. ===={{aniseries|JN}}==== [[File:Ash Hoenn Pokémon JN132.png|thumb|250px|left|Corphish encouraging Pikachu in a vision]] In ''[[JN068|Advice to Goh!]]'', Corphish reunited with Ash during his visit to Professor Oak's Laboratory with [[Goh]]. [[File:Ash Corphish Misty Clauncher.png|thumb|250px|Corphish and {{TP|Misty|Clauncher}}]] Corphish, along with the rest of Ash's Pokémon at the lab, reunited with Ash in ''[[JN114|Friends, Rivals, Lend Me Your Spirit!]]''. During the visit, he was seen relaxing with Kingler and later watched the battle between Ash and [[Paul]]. Before Ash left, he posed with the rest of Ash's Pokémon in a group photo with him. From ''[[JN118|Battling as Hard as Stone!]]'' onwards, Corphish watched Ash's [[Masters Eight Tournament]] matches against {{an|Steven Stone|Steven}}, {{an|Cynthia}}, and {{an|Leon}}. In ''[[JN132|Partners in Time!]]'', Corphish appeared as a vision to Pikachu during his battle against [[Leon's Charizard]]. After Ash won the battle, Corphish joined the rest of Ash's Pokémon at the lab in celebrating their Trainer's victory. In ''[[JN135|Heroes Unite!]]'', Corphish, along with the rest of the Pokémon at the lab, welcomed Ash back to Pallet Town after his victory over Leon. In ''[[JN138|A Fated Face-Off!]]'', Corphish was shown to have rejoined Ash's team. Corphish saw a {{p|Clauncher}} that Ash wanted to catch and formed a passionate friendship with him, only for {{an|Misty}} to appear and say she wanted to catch him instead. After trying to catch him through [[fishing]], Ash and Misty decided to have a battle to decide who would catch Clauncher, with Ash using Corphish to battle against {{TP|Misty|Politoed}}. Despite putting up a tough fight, Corphish was defeated, crying almost inconsolably at his loss, knowing that he couldn't be teammates with his new friend. Meanwhile, Misty caught {{TP|Misty|Clauncher}}, who still chose to train with Corphish, much to her dismay. ===Personality and characteristics=== [[File:Ash and Corphish.png|thumb|250px|Corphish and Ash]] [[File:Ash Corphish jealous.png|left|thumb|220px|Corphish jealous of Grovyle]] Corphish is a very brash Pokémon; he will often charge into things without thinking about his actions first, which usually leads him into some kind of trouble. Ash respected Corphish for his power, hence why he initially caught him. However, he struggled to teach Corphish how to handle his own strength, particularly regarding his pincers. Corphish is prone to jealousy and had a rivalry with [[Ash's Treecko]]. In ''[[AG067|Go Go Ludicolo!]]'', after {{AP|Treecko}} evolved into Grovyle, Corphish was worried he would not get as much attention as the powerful new Pokémon. He is also an extremely gluttonous Pokémon; in ''[[AG082|A Shroomish Skirmish]]'', Corphish ate all of {{TP|May|Torchic}}'s food. When he later got lost with Torchic, Corphish preferred to go on as if nothing had happened rather than swallowing his pride and apologizing. Despite all of its social flaws, Corphish is a very friendly Pokémon and is very loyal to his Trainer. He is also an effective battler, being able to defeat opponents quite larger in size than himself. His strength lies in his tough exoskeleton, making him durable to most attacks. Corphish tends to spend time with [[Ash's Totodile]], as shown in ''[[DP182|An Old Family Blend!]]'', where they were found near each other on [[Lily of the Valley Island]]; and in ''[[SM042|Alola, Kanto!]]'', when they were seen underwater together. He also seems to get along well with his fellow crustacean Pokémon, striking up fast friendships with both [[Ash's Kingler]] in ''[[AG133|The Right Place and the Right Mime]]'' and [[Misty's Clauncher]] in ''[[JN138|A Fated Face-Off!]]''. ===Moves used=== {{anmov/h|water||Ash Corphish {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=ViceGrip|1=BubbleBeam|2=Harden}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Vise Grip|1=Bubble Beam|2=Harden}}|image2=Ash Corphish {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Crabhammer|1=Metal Claw|2=Aqua Jet}}.png|caption2=Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Crabhammer|1=Metal Claw|2=Aqua Jet}}}} {{anmov|water|Bubble Beam|AG023|Gone Corphishin'}} {{anmov|water|Crabhammer|AG023|Gone Corphishin'|rec=yes}} {{anmov|normal|Vise Grip|AG026|Turning Over a Nuzleaf}} {{anmov|normal|Harden|AG031|Just One of the Geysers}} {{anmov|steel|Metal Claw|JN138|A Fated Face-Off!|rec=yes}} {{anmov|water|Aqua Jet|JN138|A Fated Face-Off!|rec=yes}} {{anmov/f|water}} ===Artwork=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{water color dark}}; background: #{{water color}}; font-size:80%;" |- | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{water color dark}}; background: #{{water color light}}"| [[File:AG Characters and Pokémon.png|200px]] | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{water color dark}}; background: #{{water color light}}"| [[File:Ash AG Party.png|150px]] | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{water color dark}}; background: #{{water color light}}"| [[File:PK14 JP poster.png|150px]] | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{water color dark}}; background: #{{water color light}}" | [[File:To Be a Pokémon Master poster.png|x250px]] | style="{{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{water color dark}}; background: #{{water color light}}" | [[File:JN138 AS.png|x200px]] |- | Official artwork from

In ''[[SP32|Start Of A Pokémon League!!]]'', Corphish went up against [[Morrison]]'s {{p|Girafarig}}, {{p|Growlithe}}, and {{p|Swampert}}, where it was able to defeat them since Morrison wasn't giving it his all. However, Corphish was beaten by Morrison's {{p|Steelix}}. ====Moves used==== {{anmov/h|water||Ash Corphish {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=ViceGrip|1=Crabhammer|2=Brock Marshtomp Water Gun}} AP.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 3}}|0=Vise Grip|1=Crabhammer|2=Water Gun}}}} {{anmov|normal|Vise Grip|SP32|Start Of A Pokémon League!!}} {{anmov|water|Crabhammer|SP32|Start Of A Pokémon League!!}} {{anmov|water|Water Gun|SP35|A 'Thank You' That Transcends Time|x=yes}} {{anmov/f|water|x=manga}} [[File:Ash Bayleef Corphish Krookodile JNM.png|thumb|200px|Corphish in {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}}]] ===Pokémon Journeys=== Corphish appeared in ''[[JNM20|Advice to Goh!]]'' at [[Professor Oak's Laboratory]]. {{-}} ==Trivia== * Corphish is the only {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that {{Ash}} {{pkmn2|caught}} in [[Hoenn]] that is capable of [[Evolution|evolving]] but has not done so. ** Corphish is also Ash's only Pokémon caught in Hoenn with a confirmed gender. * Corphish is the last of Ash's Pokémon to have a proper onscreen battle during {{aniseries|PTS}}. ** Corphish is also the latest of Ash's Pokémon to have his gender confirmed. * ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]'' is the only series since his debut where Corphish doesn’t appear in any capacity during ''Pokémon the Series''. ==References== ==Related articles== {{Animespecies|Corphish}} {{Ash's Pokémon|water}} {{Project Anime notice|no}} [[Category:Ash's Pokémon|Corphish]] [[Category:Pokémon with manga move errors]] [[Category:Ash & Pikachu characters]] [[de:Ashs Krebscorps]] [[es:Corphish de Ash]] [[fr:Écrapince de Sacha]] [[it:Corphish di Ash]] [[ja:サトシのヘイガニ]] [[zh:小智的龙虾小兵]]
